name: Letters assemble
look: A statement of two to five words, set very large: its letters start scattered, shifted and turned, and fly into the line one after the other as the statement rises through the screen, whole before it reaches the middle.
phone: The statement stands as written, in a smaller size.

needs.words: a statement of 2 to 5 words (up to about 28 letters) and one or two lines under it
